source_to_target.sampling: Deterministic pseudorandom area-weighted triangle surface samples; Euclidean world-space nearest surface; source native Blender Z-up; animated tracks muted at neutral frame 1; target role=internal excluded.

interpolated_loop_normal_difference_deg.method: Barycentric interpolation of imported per-corner split normals, normalized in world space, at each sample and closest triangle point; ignores texture normal maps; nearest-surface ambiguity around intersecting/double-sided shells can raise normal angles.

target_to_source.sampling: Deterministic pseudorandom area-weighted triangle surface samples; Euclidean world-space nearest surface; source native Blender Z-up; animated tracks muted at neutral frame 1; target role=internal excluded.

interpolated_loop_normal_difference_deg.method: Barycentric interpolation of imported per-corner split normals, normalized in world space, at each sample and closest triangle point; ignores texture normal maps; nearest-surface ambiguity around intersecting/double-sided shells can raise normal angles.

quality_gate.limitation: Sampled surface distances, not a strict mathematical Hausdorff bound; both directions required.
